doc: Per-warp queue behind mio_throttle / lg_throttle (warp_queue protocol Q1-Q4). A member instruction (STS, LDS, SHFL.IDX, SHFL.BFLY, LDG, STG; not predicated off, not a remote shared access) is an entry of its warp's queue from issue until its release; it cannot issue while queue_depth_count entries are unreleased. One release server per warp: start = max(free, issue + start_latency_cycles + start_interval_ratio * release_interval_cycles), release = start + release_interval_cycles, free = release (fractions kept). is_global_entry selects the ledger reason (warp_queue:lg when the waiting instruction and every unreleased entry are global, else warp_queue:mio). has_chain_turn: the entry also takes a turn of release_interval_cycles in the warp's return chain 1 (stores; the result time of the store itself is unchanged). The width partition is the operand width of the lane (bytes) from the capture; LDS / LDG / SHFL release intervals do not depend on it. SM level (warp_queue v2 S1-S4): sm_start_interval_cycles is the length of the slot a release needs in its (SM, operation class) server (0 = none; an STG takes it only on the store fast path: a global store of at least 4 bytes per lane inside one 128-byte line, the line the warp's previous global store wrote, which skips the store buffer); sm_depth_count bounds the unreleased entries of all warps of an SM (0 = no bound); result_after_release_cycles floors the result of a member load at release + c (0 = none).
